steps.description: A reviewer has decided how to treat the difference on **{{invoice_ref}}** against payment **{{payment_ref}}**. Work through the checklist, then submit the Reconciliation outcome form.

subtasks.label: Open the invoice in the ledger and confirm the balance after the decision
If a credit note was posted, allocate it to the invoice in the ledger (the connector creates it but does not allocate)
If a credit note was posted, review its tax treatment
If the invoice stays open, contact the customer about the shortfall and note their answer
Attach the ledger extract that shows the final balance
